title: The Map of Nowhere
text: A map lies unrolled on the ground in the dark, weighted at the corners with stones. It shows exactly where you stand, down to those stones. It also shows a clear, well-marked road running off into the black, a road that is not there.

options.label: Follow the road that is not there, and trust the map.

outcomes.text: The road is there when you walk it, and it is short.
It leads somewhere else entirely. The map shows no way back.

options.label: The wisest studies the hand that drew it, and how it knew.

outcomes.text: It is your own hand, years from now. The ink is not yet dry.

options.label: Burn the map before it leads anyone else astray.

outcomes.text: The ash spells a word you do not know. Somewhere far off, something loses its way.
